title: Midday traffic and safety

items.label: I-280 SB → NB SR-85
items.text: Traffic hazard on the SB I-280 transition to NB SR-85 (San Jose / Cupertino connector), ~12:07–12:08 PM PT. Black bag in lane 2 (CHP #1210). Unit assigned/enroute 12:16 PM; still active ~12:25 PM. May delay 280→85. Union Ave / Campbell via SR-17 unaffected.

items.label: Moorpark Ave · San Jose
items.text: Still on board: collision with ambulance en route at 2400 Moorpark Ave (~12:04 PM PT). Near I-280 / Winchester, a couple miles north of Campbell / Union Ave.
